text:
You need a careful migration from Wave Accounting to QuickBooks Online, including receipts, amounts, tax, and complete expense and invoice details, with everything carried over accurately.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, data entry, and data cleaning, with strong skills in Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, and Power BI. I’m detail-oriented and used to working with structured financial data, so I can help ensure your Wave records are transferred cleanly and consistently into QBO.

I understand how important it is to preserve the receipt attachments and transaction details, not just the numbers. My focus will be on accuracy, organization, and making sure the migrated data is complete and easy to review.

If you’d like, I can help get this migration handled carefully and efficiently.
